text: Completed Phase 6. FmriDataset/DatasetIndex are pure descriptions; explicit DatasetSeriesReader and SynchronousFmriDataset retain synchronous compatibility. OpenedDataset[F] performs accumulated typed acquisition attachment, run-local selection lowering, explicit bijective sample alignment, and receipt/provenance-preserving reads without resampling. Fit and MVPA have effectful OpenedDataset executors while models/plans/kernels remain pure. ScalafimRuntime.openDataset owns archive, representation, and attachment resource lifecycles with typed archive versus attachment failures. Removed archive/latent-owned cases from DatasetError. Permanent interop -> dataset edge installed. Verified focused JVM/JS suites, repository-wide compileAll and testAll, Phase 0 numerical corpus, static boundary scans, and git diff --check.
